LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_None: No particular part in the group: just one of them, which is most people.
LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_Anchor: The one the group gathers round: warm, sure of themselves, good with people, with the most friends among them. They call the others together, and the group often bears their name.
LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_Joker: The one who makes the jokes. When one of them is low, the joker is the one who gets a laugh out of them.
LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_Peacemaker: Warm and slow to anger. When two of the group quarrel and the peacemaker is there, they step in, and the quarrel is over sooner.
LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_Firebrand: Quick-tempered and proud. They stir the group up, most of all against a group it's at odds with.
LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_Worrier: Gloomy and big-hearted: they fret for everyone, and the others talk them down.
LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_Quiet: Says little and is there anyway: a cup kept full, a nod across the fire.
LanguageData.CC_GroupRoleTip_Newcomer: Joined lately, and still finding their place. After ten days or so they settle into a part of their own.
LanguageData.CC_Group_RivalWhy_Ways: their ways being what they are
LanguageData.CC_Group_Accepted: {GROUP} have taken {PAWN_nameDef} in: {PAWN_pronoun} is no longer the new one.
LanguageData.CC_Group_ClosedRanks: {GROUP} have closed ranks against {PAWN_nameDef}, who is new here.
LanguageData.CC_Group_SplitInTwo: {GROUP} have split in two, {WHY}: {NAMES} go their own way as {OTHER}.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Merged: {OTHER} and {GROUP} have become one crowd, and all of them are {GROUP} now.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Rivalry: Bad blood: {GROUP} and {OTHER} are at odds, {WHY}.
LanguageData.CC_GroupNote_Found: Already together when the colony began keeping track of its circles. {WHY}
LanguageData.CC_GroupNote_JoinedWith: {PAWN_nameDef} was taken in, with {OTHER} speaking for {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_GroupNote_Sponsor: {PAWN_nameDef} spoke up for {OTHER_nameDef}, who is new.
LanguageData.CC_GroupNote_ClosedRanks: Closed ranks against {PAWN_nameDef}, who is new.
LanguageData.CC_GroupNote_Norm: A way of theirs took hold: {NORM}.
LanguageData.CC_GroupNote_Merged: Took in {OTHER}: the two are one now.
LanguageData.CC_Cause_ShutOut: {0} keep a newcomer at arm's length
LanguageData.CC_Group_Card_OutOfStep: Out of step with its ways: {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Card_ClosedTip: The group has closed ranks against them: its ways and its people's wariness keep them out. Work alongside its people, meals at the same table and a member who likes them all help, slowly.
LanguageData.CC_Group_CohesionTip: How close the group is, 0 to 100. Habits kept together, things gone through together and a peacemaker's work raise it; quarrels inside it, a member lost and long separation lower it. A loose group with a rift in it splits.
LanguageData.CC_Group_ViewTip: A view most of them share. Members who don't hold it yet are drawn towards it, slowly.
LanguageData.CC_Group_RivalTip: How bad it is between them: {0} of 100. It grows with feuds between their people, views and ways at odds, and spats between them; it cools when those end. Members of groups at odds think less of each other, vote against each other and object to each other's wishes.
LanguageData.CC_Group_OutsiderTip: Someone new to the colony is an outsider until a group takes them in. What its people think of them, things they go through together, work they share and a member who speaks for them all help; a warm, trusting group takes them in far sooner than a wary one, which may close ranks.
LanguageData.CC_Group_NoneTip: Groups grow out of what binds people: friendship, the same work, a fight fought together, the night hours, faith, where they came from, their age, being alike.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Page_NoRole: no particular part in it yet
LanguageData.CC_Group_Page_OutOfStep: Out of step with the ways of {GROUP}: {NORM}.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Page_FindingWay: New here, finding a way into {GROUP} ({PCT}% of the way).
LanguageData.CC_Group_Page_ShutOut: New here, and {GROUP} have closed ranks against {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_Group_Page_NewNoGroup: New here, and not yet part of any group.
LanguageData.CC_Social_GroupsNone: No groups yet. They grow out of friendships, shared work, battles fought together, the night hours, faith, where people came from, age and character, and take a few days to show.
LanguageData.CC_Social_Outsiders: New and still outside every group: {0}.
